body:

Adds The Official Nametag Recipe Early! It's a datapack so it's still considered vanilla Minecraft when you use it on non-modded Minecraft!

**_this mod was made very fast by me with quality in mind immediatelyafter the youtube video dropped![Shapeless recipe of the gold nugget and the paper needed to craft the nametag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0cd53b0adbb69bed3b2a68c39ce1da853b2592fd_0.webp)_**
